I replied to Tobias in the thread: the ticket is #8841.

It comes from his own message in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. That message calls it his "dealer account", not Marrow Fieldworks by name. So in my reply I said #8841 is the number for his notes if that account is Marrow Fieldworks.

He's in #central-random, so he could already see that message. I left out the guessed ticket number he sent me privately in our DM.
